step1_analysis.description: A soft error rate (SER) tolerant latch designed with local redundancy to mitigate single event upsets. The provided netlist appears to be a partial extraction containing several dummy transistors and a partial latching loop, where internal nodes track the data input.

paper_reference.title: Measurements and Analysis of SER-Tolerant Latch in a 90-nm Dual-VT CMOS Process

dynamic_power.description: Average power consumption during active clock and data switching.

sky130_expected.calculation: P = C * V^2 * f. With ~10fF internal capacitance, 1.8V supply, and 125MHz data rate -> ~10uW.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Based on standard dynamic power estimation for a few logic gates in 130nm at 1.8V.

leakage_power.description: Static power consumption when inputs are held constant.

paper_reported.value: Analyzed effects of leakage on SER robustness

sky130_expected.reasoning: Estimated subthreshold leakage for the given transistor widths in SKY130.

propagation_delay.description: Delay from Data input to internal node N0B.

sky130_expected.reasoning: RC delay of the pass transistor and parasitic capacitance in the 130nm node.

step3_testbench.description: Transient analysis to measure dynamic power and propagation delay of the latch structure.
